notes.title: ONGKAU, READY TO BUY! DETAILS ON PACKAGES AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Hi All,

Just a quick note to say that we really hope you enjoy our game; we worked really hard on the gameplay and features to allow you to play it how you want.

Also, a quick note on the different bundles available:

1. ONGAKU: The core game only, no DLC's

2. ONGAKU UPGRADE: For those of you who have brought the main game, you can buy the 9 DLC's and soundtrack in one bundle to bolt onto the main game

3. Finally, ONGAKU COMPLETE: The core game, 9 DLC's and soundtrack, all in one bundle.

Once again, hope you enjoy the game; please spread the word if you do.

Thanks

Z
